audit.whatIsWrong: The page labels the lane 'EVEN' while every other field on it says otherwise: diffRating 8.5/10, a red tone, 'Hard matchup' in the final rating and five of seven chart rows to Jayce. Separately, the chart itself is disputed — the packet gives Skill/Renekton/Jayce/Skill/Renekton/Jayce/Skill while both champ-data layers read Jayce/Jayce/Jayce/Skill/Jayce/Skill/Jayce.
audit.why: The mirror (jayce__renekton) found the same chart disagreement and deliberately changed no side or rating, flagging it for the user. The two layers here agree with each other row for row, so nothing is broken on the page; changing rows unilaterally would break the mirror instead.
audit.corrected: diff moved from EVEN to HARD so the label matches the 8.5/10 rating, the red tone and the final-rating line. Chart left untouched pending the user's ruling.

audit.whatIsWrong: The First-item row credited your Eclipse; spikes[2] and whys[5] both say Jayce's Sheen is the item that moves that window.
audit.why: Sheen turns his hammer-form Q into real burst while your Eclipse timing is the same window.
audit.corrected: phases[5].why rewritten to name Sheen and the Fury requirement.

audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer knows only 'Shock Blast: his main poke, dodge it'. Three interactions that decide the lane were missing: the weapon swap is a 6s ability whose first attack in Cannon form reduces your Armor and Magic Resist — and it resets his auto, so the swap animation is the burst tell, not the ability cast; Thundering Blow (Hammer E) is a knockback that ejects you out of your own combo on a 20s rank-1 cooldown; and a Shock Blast fired through Acceleration Gate gains missile speed, range and damage, which is why crossing the gate line matters.
audit.why: Jayce R: 6s, 'The first attack in this form reduces the target's Armor and Magic Resist.' E Hammer: 'knocks them back a short distance', 20/18/16/14/12/10. E Cannon: 'If Shock Blast is fired through the gate the missile speed, range, and damage will increase.' Q: 16/14/12/10/8/6.
audit.corrected: Swap tell and the shred in report[5].t; Shock Blast's 16s in dosFull[0].d; the knockback and its 20s in dontsFull[1].d; the gate buff in dontsFull[0].d.

notes: I deliberately made no chart edits. The mirror found the same conflict — packet levelChart says Skill/Renekton/Jayce/Skill/Renekton/Jayce/Skill, both champ-data layers say Jayce/Jayce/Jayce/Skill/Jayce/Skill/Jayce — and changed nothing, so touching it here would create the disagreement the mirror avoided. The two layers on this page do agree with each other, so nothing renders inconsistently today.
